text: O tagirii kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin, ñenƴal yottiingal, ko fijindaaru alaa e mu'un, wano tooñuɓe ɓen aaƴorta. Himo suddira jemma on, ñalawma on, O suddira kadi ñalorma on, jemma on. O elti naange ngen e lewru ndun, tawi kala majji, hino doga haa e happu eɓɓaaɗo, on woni lannugol ɗam nguurndam. Haray anndee, ko Kanko woni Fooluɗo, yoftotoowo ayɓe Mun, Mo gooto foolataa, Haforoowo junuubi kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen.
